title: Fantastic
body: Giving 4 stars because it wiuld be nice to be able to group habits into routines and have a calendar view for each routine (full square for routine completed, faded square for some habuts done, empty for a day where no habits were done). But I am of course aware of the extra work this creates and can’t complain since the app is free.
author: idkbruhleavemealone

title: It’s perfect
body: Simple but effective. The only missing thing is having it on your Apple Watch, but thanks anyway for the free app!
author: Rodrigo Iglesias

title: Best Tracker
body: Thank you a lot for creating and giving it to us for free! It is by far my favorite habit tracker. The only feature I would love to see is a graph view and maybe a “joker” when long pressing on the daily check mark… than it would be the 11/10
author: Vensu-Art

title: Habit Streaks
body:
I really enjoy using this app — it’s intuitive, motivating, and has become part of my daily routine.

However, I’ve encountered one challenge: my daily progress doesn’t seem to be tracked weekly, so I’m unable to see how many days in a row I’ve maintained a habit. As a result, I often lose my streaks, which can be a bit discouraging.

I believe it would be incredibly helpful to have a feature that shows weekly progress and keeps track of streaks over time.

Thank you for all the work you put into making this app so helpful !
author: polzais

title: Simple but powerful
body:
So many thanks to the developer behind the app for making such a simple-to-use free app but yet very powerful. It doesn’t have all the glitter that other “productivity” apps has, so it helps me stay focused.

Only thing I miss is a version for the Apple Watch. It doesn‘t need to have all the features, but a quick read-only view of the habits, tap to record habit and the focus/break features, that would be PERFECT ✨

Again thank you so much, hope you have a great day!
author: Álvaro Hernández Perales

title: La mejor aplicación de hábitos
body: La mejor aplicación de hábitos que he probado. Sencilla y funcional con buen diseño. Solo le falta sincronización con iCloud o una manera de exportar/importar los datos para ser 100% perfecta.

title: Fabuloso!
body: Finalmente um app de hábitos bonito e gostoso de usar e que realmente ajuda a cumprir as metas.

title: Streaks?
body: Really like it! But the “streaks doesn’t work or I don’t understand them 😅
author: Frida iPhone 4S

title: Great and super easy-to-use app
body:
Loved this app and how easy it makes goal tracking! I’m recommending it to all my friends :) 
However I am missing some easy interface capabilities:
- the possibility to reorder my habits (reshuffle the list):. I’d like to open the app and see my highest priority goals at the top, be able to rearrange them as during different times of the year priorities might shift (e.g: holidays) and not have to scroll down.
- add comments to habits: possibility to add quick notes (example: what defines my habit “Work-life balance” would be leave work by 19:00 on weekdays but not working at all on weekends
- show your habit buddies when they accept your habit invitation and start tracking it as well

Thanks for a great app!
